metadata.description: Wire format shared by the success responses from both DELETE package routes: whole-package removal and one-version removal. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/packages.rs` (`DeleteResponse`, `delete_package`, `delete_version`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/package_delete_response/`.
The removed target's reverse-FQDN group qualifier.
The removed target's bare package name.
The removed semantic version, or null when the request targeted the whole package. The key is always present because the writer does not skip its Option.
Whether the target stood before the idempotent delete.
